doc.hypothesis: The six rules with a real edge before costs make money after costs when they trade only the day's biggest expected movers, because a bigger move makes the fixed costs a smaller share.
doc.signals: The six rules' signals in the research dataset y2 (runner.py --features six, code f8d054b), with their simulated outcome at market entry and measured costs (net_bp, pessimistic reading).
doc.filter: Keep a signal only if its stock is in the top 40 of that day's point-in-time universe by the expected-move model's 09:45 prediction — the model chosen by P5_move_model, as predicted walk-forward (fitted only on earlier months).
doc.metric: Mean net bp per signal on the holdout, t-statistic clustered by session; per rule and pooled.
doc.decision: GO for a rule (and pooled): filtered holdout mean net per signal > 0 AND clustered t >= 2. NO-GO otherwise. Always reported: the unfiltered mean beside it, and the development period.
doc.multiple_testing: Six rules plus the pool: a GO makes a forward-test candidate (Phase 10), not a verdict.
